description_expanded: OverviewWaterview with Private Beach access-Blue Mountain Beach`Emerald Retreat`The Space Emerald Retreat – Steps to Private Beach in a Gated Community! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Steps to Private Beach Access – Enjoy uncrowded, pristine white sands Spacious 3-Story Townhome – Perfect for families & groups 3 Bedrooms / 2.5 Bathrooms – Comfortable & stylish accommodations Community Pool & Hot Tub – Relax in the Olympic-sized pool & bubbling spa. Pool heated Thanksgiving and Christmas weeks only. Private Balcony with Gulf Views – Wake up to breathtaking coastal scenery 3 Adult Bikes Included – Cruise 30A’s scenic paths & charming beach towns Gated Community – Enjoy security & privacy during your stay Wi-Fi Included – Stay connected while you unwind General Parking Available – Hassle-free & convenient Welcome to Emerald Retreat Enjoy the incredible beaches of the 30a area as you vacation in this top-of-the-line townhome. This is the ultimate retreat. The townhome features three stories. Emerald Retreat offers three bedrooms and 2 full and half bathrooms. The first floor holds the bunk room with a twin over full bunk bed and private bathroom. On the second floor you will find the open kitchen, living and dining rooms. These bright and airy rooms are the perfect space for unwinding with your family and ultimate relaxation. One more floor up and you will find two more bedrooms. The first bedroom includes a king-sized bed and a futon. This bedroom has a private balcony with Gulf views! Also, on this floor you will find the queen guest bedroom with futon. Both of these bedrooms on the share a bathroom. The Sea Haunts residential community features endless amenities that provide a special vacation. The sparkling emerald gulf is just a short stroll away, and a giant Olympic sized community swimming pool overlooks a tropical lagoon. A bubbling hot tub provides soothing relaxation, and the neighboring pool is heated during the cooler times of the year. A pedestrian bridge crosses over the lovely lagoon and leads you over a gorgeous dune to the bright white sandy beaches below. **No Cable. Streaming Only** **30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival** **No Pets! No Smoking! No Parties! The primary renter must be at least 25 years old with a ratio of one adult over 25 per 3 under 25 during spring break and summer seasons.** SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (7): 3rd floor Master bedroom 1 king bed (1 twin cushion cot in closet) 3rd floor Queen bedroom 1 queen bed (1 twin cushion cot in closet) 1st floor Bunk Bedroom 1 double bed lower bunk 1 twin bed upper bunk AREA ATTRACTIONS: Welcome to Blue Mountain Beach, a hidden gem along Florida’s scenic Highway 30A! Known for its breathtaking white sand beaches, vibrant turquoise waters, and relaxed coastal charm, this community is the perfect destination for those seeking great food, sweet treats, shopping, and outdoor adventures. Start your day with a delicious breakfast at Blue Mountain Bakery, then swing by For the Health of It for quick grocery essentials and organic treats. When it’s time for lunch or dinner, savor fresh seafood and coastal flavors at Red Fish Taco, Shunk Gulley, or Cowgirl Kitchen, all just a short bike ride away. Enjoy some shopping at The Stalls on 30A, where you’ll find unique local treasures and coastal-inspired finds. And when it’s time for something sweet, indulge in homemade ice cream from Blue Mountain Beach Creamery, just a quick stroll from your doorstep. Whether you’re here to unwind on the beach, explore the area, or simply soak in the laid-back 30A lifestyle, you’ve found the perfect place to stay! Show less
